submission.justification: No fully valid selection could be established because the hard residual-dose requirement could not be verified: the recorded project/spec data contain no usable dose information and zero dose-compliant materials were identified. If a material/thickness must nevertheless be submitted, Absorber-F1 at 4.3 mm is the best performance choice from the available simulations, giving the best observed 100 GeV energy resolution of 3.021%, better than the prior 5 mm F1 result of 3.2% and better than the 5 mm results for F2 and F3. This recommendation is therefore conditional on subsequent dose qualification; as recorded, the hard dose constraint remains unresolved.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: There are three candidate options recorded; the submitted option is Absorber-F1, one of the enumerated candidate materials.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: Dose limit is recorded as 20 uSv/h, but candidate_specs_dose_data_available=0, allowed_materials_identified_from_dose=0, and dose_compliant_materials_count=0; no material was demonstrated compliant.
Submitted thickness is 4.3 mm, within the recorded allowed range of 2 to 10 mm.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: For F1, the best observed simulated result was at 4.3 mm with 3.021% resolution. Prior 5 mm results were F1 3.2%, F2 3.9%, and F3 5.1%, making F1 the best available simulated material and 4.3 mm the best observed thickness.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Absorber-F1 with 4.3 mm plate thickness.
